callouts.title: Lebesgue微分定理
callouts.body:
如果$f \in L^1_{\text{loc}}(\mathbb{R}^m)$那么下面极限几乎处处成立：$$\lim_{\begin{aligned}m(B)&\to 0 \\x \in
B\end{aligned}}\frac{1}{m(B)}\int_{B} f(y)dy = f(x)$$
即几乎所有点都是Lebesgue点。

if_problem.statement_en: If $f \in L^1_{\text{loc}}(\mathbb{R}^m)$, then the following limit holds almost everywhere: $$\lim_{\begin{aligned}m(B)&\to 0 \\x \in B\end{aligned}}\frac{1}{m(B)}\int_{B} f(y)dy = f(x)$$ That is, almost every point is a Lebesgue point.

callouts.title: Lebesgue密度定理
callouts.body:
集合$A$是$\mathbb{R}^n$当中Lebesgue可测的子集，那么对于几乎所有点而言$$d_A(x)=1_A(x)\text{ for a.e. }x\in \mathbb{R}^n$$

一般来说如果一个点$x$对应的$d_A(x)=1$那么我们一般称其为"集合A的密度点"或者说a point of density for A。

if_problem.statement_en: Let $A$ be a Lebesgue measurable subset of $\mathbb{R}^n$. Then for almost every point, $$d_A(x)=1_A(x)\text{ for a.e. }x\in \mathbb{R}^n$$ In general, if a point $x$ satisfies $d_A(x)=1$, then it is called a density point of $A$.
